anchors.description: Overall outer width of the aluminium-framed double glass entrance door at the left of the facade, measured across the top frame between its outer left and outer right corners (two leaf modules).
anchors.visible_evidence: Both corners are the visible top outer corners of the same metal door frame; the two equal leaves meet at a central stile with the lever handle, so the frame spans two standard ~1.0 m leaf modules.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Leaf nominal width could be 0.9 m (total ~1.85-1.9 m) rather than 1.0 m; frame profile adds a few cm per side.

anchors.description: Clear height of the same left double door, from the top outer frame corner down to the door bottom at the threshold on the right jamb.
anchors.visible_evidence: Top frame corner and the bottom of the same door leaf where it meets the threshold paving are both clearly visible; the door is a full-height external entrance door with no transom in this lower unit.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard external door height 2.1 m; if the unit is 2.2 m high the estimate is 5% low. Bottom point sits at the frame/threshold junction.

anchors.description: Height of the recessed central glass entrance door, from the top-right outer frame corner down to the bottom-right corner of the same frame at floor level.
anchors.visible_evidence: The two points lie on the right jamb of the same glazed door frame, top corner and bottom corner, both facing the camera in the recessed entrance.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Second door of the same building standard; height could be 2.0-2.2 m, and the bottom point may be one frame width above the floor slab.
